Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Role

As the Director of Product Management on the Digital Marketing Technology team, you will lead the strategic evolution of our brand and practitioner-facing websites portfolio into an AI-Native, Human-Led ecosystem. You wlll be responsible for transforming our digital presence from static experiences into an intelligent, agentic web where Al is an extension of the user's intellect. Your mandate is to lead the shift from traditional development cycles to rapid-innovation, spec-driven environment where brand vision is machine-readable and executable by agents.

You'll own the roadmap, the user experience, the design partners and pilot programs.

This is an IC role for a builder who thinks in agents. You use coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.) daily and have a point of view on where they're going. You prototype before you spec. You treat an agent like a co-worker — not a tool you prompt once and forget, but a collaborator you brief, course-correct, and build trust with over time. You know how to set context, divide work, and close the loop when an agent goes off the rails. You've built and evaluated agents yourself, and you have opinions about what makes agent optimization actually work — evaluation harnesses, annotation flows, failure clustering, and the feedback loops that turn raw session data into product intelligence.

What You'll Do

Own the product end to end

Set and own the roadmap, outcomes, and product strategy for our brand and role-based websites.
Own the user experience. Partner with design to build sites that our business partners, customers, and communities trust and reach for, not one they tolerate.
Set and defend success metrics (pilot activation, failure-cluster coverage, recommendation acceptance, agent quality lift) and use them to make real trade-offs. Kill what isn't working.

Build, don't just describe

Prototype with coding agents to pressure-test ideas before writing a spec. A working demo beats a 10-page doc.
Dogfood the product constantly. Run it against real customer data. Break it. Eval it. Bring receipts.
Stay close to the code and the runtime. Read the traces. Understand the eval harness. Sit next to engineering during discovery.

Run the customer program

Run the design partner program directly. Lead pilot calls, extract requirements, turn customer pain into shipped product.
Bring the customer voice into every product decision. Distinguish real needs from workarounds, one-offs, and badly framed requests.

Move fast and coordinate across the portfolio

Push a fast-paced environment. Ship the smallest thing that works, learn, iterate.
Coordinate with peer PMs across Digital Marketing Terchnology — the runtime, the authoring surfaces, evaluation, and the broader Observability portfolio — fits into the ADLC as one coherent story.
Communicate clearly with engineers, designers, execs, and business partners. Bring a point of view and change your mind when the data says to.

Required Qualifications

Product Management Experience: 5+ years of experience shipping products for technical users (developers, admins, or SMEs). Proven track record of scope and impact in an enterprise or startup environment.
AI & Coding-Agent Fluency: Daily user of coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.). Substantive knowledge of LLM orchestration, tool use, and evaluation frameworks (evaluation harnesses, annotation flows, failure clustering).
Builder and Execution Mindset: Comfortable with ambiguity and biased for action. You prototype early to pressure-test ideas and turn fuzzy problems into sharp bets with measurable outcomes.
Communication & Cross-functional Leadership: Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to rally teams across engineering, design, and operations while holding your own with executives.
Customer Empathy at Scale: Ability to synthesize signals across a design partner cohort and distill customer pain into crisp product requirements and shipped products.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in a technical, business, or analytical discipline.
Engineering background, or the equivalent hands-on depth — comfortable reading code, reviewing APIs, prototyping in a notebook, and partnering with engineers on real trade-offs.
Direct experience with the current agent-building and eval landscape (Cursor, Claude Code, Replit, LangSmith, Braintrust, Langfuse, agent frameworks, headless CMS) and strong opinions on what they get right and wrong.
Experience with websites, customer-facing pilot or design-partner programs for early-stage AI products.
Prior experience on a 0-to-1 or innovation team.
Design sense: can turn messy systems into clean primitives with opinionated defaults.
Experience operating with autonomy in a highly cross-functional environment, including executive, technical, and go-to-market stakeholders.
Experience with CRM and Marketing Technology ecosystems, Web design, Slack, and Contentful.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

The Director of Help Agent AI & Tooling leads the team accountable for the generative AI capabilities, evaluation tooling, observability, and emerging program initiatives that power Salesforce's Help Agent — a customer-facing Agentforce deployment and one of Salesforce's flagship Customer Zero implementations. Evaluations Tooling

Support the creation and delivery of AI Skills via applications like Slackbot, Claude Code and others to support the team's ability to deliver evaluations, insights, and opportunity sourcing for Roadmap development.

Act as a Customer Zero steward — representing Salesforce's own use of Agentforce as a reference customer, surfacing product gaps and driving roadmap influence through Shiproom intakes and direct T&P partnerships

Lead cross-functional collaboration with Technology Teams to align on evaluations, retrieval strategies, and tooling development
Define and mature the AI Evaluations Framework, moving from manual, spreadsheet-based processes toward scalable, automated evaluation at production scale
Drive the observability roadmap in partnership with Technology Teams, from current OOTB capabilities to a fully centralized, production-grade monitoring platform
Represent AI & Tooling in leadership forums and communicate progress, risks, and strategic direction clearly to senior stakeholders

Help Agent resolution rate and quality scores (completeness, correctness, relevance) improve quarter-over-quarter through disciplined evaluation and rapid iteration
End-to-end latency - Deliver high quality answers as fast as possible for the application.
A centralized, production-grade observability platform is fully adopted by the team as the single source of truth for agent performance
The Testing Center is fully onboarded in production, with evaluation coverage scaled well beyond current manual limits
The NNAOV Program generates measurable pipeline contribution from Help Agent interactions
Tooling is standardized and integrated across the Data & AI team, eliminating fragmented, ad hoc approaches
AI & Tooling functions as a center of excellence for generative AI evaluation and tooling practices across Digital Success and the broader Salesforce Customer Zero ecosystem

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
10 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
5 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).
5 years of experience in people management, with experience in technical leadership.

Preferred qualifications:

12 years of experience in product management, with a proven track record of leading and launching large-scale product portfolios in the AI/ML or Generative AI space.
Experience building and scaling 0-to-1 products in a highly ambiguous, fast-paced environment, with a history of driving significant organizational and business impact.
Deep technical expertise in architecting agentic AI products, with the ability to guide engineering teams through complex architectural trade-offs.
Exceptional executive presence and communication skills, with demonstrated ability to navigate matrixed organizations, resolve cross-functional bottlenecks, and influence VP-level stakeholders and external partners.

About The Job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

In this role, you will be a product leader who defines and drives the AI product strategy for Google Partner Innovation. You will lead a team of product managers and designers to steer a portfolio of cutting-edge AI products that showcase the best of Google's AI capabilities, acting as a strategic bridge between foundational research and market-defining commercial applications. You will forge executive-level partnerships across DeepMind, Core ML, and global engineering teams to transform research breakthroughs into scalable, user-centric solutions. You will own the strategic direction of the product lifecycle across multiple initiatives, empowering cross-functional teams to bring groundbreaking AI solutions to market. You will require a profound technical background in modern AI architectures and the ability to influence highly complex technical and business decisions.

Responsibilities

Define and drive the multi-year strategic product goal for Google Partner Innovation, identifying disruptive, high-impact AI product opportunities within complex consumer and partner ecosystems.
Drive seamless operational and commercial synergy with the Office of the APAC RVP team, ensuring unified delivery across strategic partner bets, cross-solution projects, and emerging business models.
Forge strategic alignment across executive leadership in DeepMind, Core ML, and other engineering teams to transition foundational AI research into market-ready products.
Direct the overarching product development lifecycle for a portfolio of AI initiatives, establishing frameworks for rapid prototyping, evaluation, and iteration to ensure exceptional delivery.
Cultivate deep partnerships with Product Alliance Managers and Business Leaders to construct compelling go-to-market strategies and narratives that highlight the transformative value of Google's AI solutions.

Core is the owner and advocate for the cross-Google user experience, underlying design elements, safety and privacy technology, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google.

Position Overview

The Sr. Director, Product Management — DV Marketplace Suite owns the product vision, strategy, roadmap and delivery for DVMS: DoubleVerify's solution for protecting and optimizing programmatic marketplaces. DVMS provides fraud/IVT protection, brand suitability and viewability measurement across desktop, mobile web, mobile app and CTV, helping platforms, exchanges and publishers ensure marketplace inventory is human, viewable and brand-safe. It is one of DV's fastest-growing businesses.

Your customers are the marketplaces themselves — SSPs, exchanges, ad networks and DSPs — who license DV's measurement and pre-bid capabilities to differentiate their supply to buyers. That makes this a distinctive product challenge: you are building for users who work inside someone else's platform, on someone else's release cycle, under commercial terms negotiated partner by partner. Success depends as much on integration design, packaging and partner economics as it does on features.

The role is highly cross-functional by design. DVMS is powered by capabilities that span the company — fraud detection, brand suitability, viewability, attention, pre-bid segment infrastructure, measurement tag foundations and data delivery. Turning that breadth into a coherent marketplace product, and building the partnerships across DV needed to deliver it, is the core of the job. This is a role for someone who excels at collaboration, relationship-building and ideating creative solutions.

You will lead a small, senior product team and be accountable for product strategy and execution that drives revenue growth: extending measurement into new quality dimensions, deepening supply-path and inventory-quality insight, bringing attention measurement to new marketplaces, leveraging AI-powered innovation, and expanding DV's reach across the programmatic ecosystem. You will set the strategy that keeps DVMS the market leader in a fast-moving and competitive category.

Job Responsibilities

Own and be accountable for the DVMS product vision, strategy, roadmap and revenue outcomes across the DV Marketplace Suite portfolio.
Lead, coach and grow a team of Product Managers; set the standard for discovery, prioritization and cross-organizational execution, and develop the next generation of product leaders on the team.
Grow the business through new and existing products — new invalid-traffic and quality measurement dimensions, supply path and inventory quality insights, attention measurement for marketplaces, and partner programs that extend reach into emerging and mid-tail supply.
Maintain a clear, evidence-based view of the competitive landscape and ensure DVMS stays ahead of it across fraud, quality and supply transparency.
Build and sustain the cross-functional partnerships DVMS delivery depends on — securing clear commitments and a durable operating rhythm with the programmatic, measurement, classification, fraud and platform infrastructure teams whose capabilities power the suite.
Develop deep understanding of how SSPs, exchanges, ad networks and DSPs operate, monetize, and evaluate a measurement partner — and design DV's products to fit those realities.
Partner with Business Development and Platform Sales on pricing, packaging, contracting and revenue attribution for platform deals; support commercial teams in closing and expanding platform partnerships.
Own the product side of major marketplace partner relationships, including technical integration design, joint roadmap alignment, and executive-level partner reviews; partner with DV's Integrations organization on turnkey and custom integrations.
Own the product direction for the DVMS partner-facing interface and reporting experience.
Drive delivery velocity in close partnership with the dedicated DVMS engineering organization; establish clear requirements, make explicit prioritization decisions, and manage scope.
Partner with Product Marketing, Product Analytics, Revenue Operations and Finance on the business operations layer behind the product — usage tracking, rate application, product-level revenue attribution and product health reporting.
Represent DV in industry standards bodies and working groups relevant to supply-side and open measurement, and at industry events.

Minimum Qualifications

10+ years of total professional experience, including 7+ years in Product Management.
2+ years of people management experience with Product Managers as direct reports.
4+ years of product experience in the advertising technology ecosystem, with direct exposure to the marketplace side — SSPs, exchanges, ad networks, DSPs, or platform-side measurement and data integrations.
Demonstrated success delivering products through influence rather than direct authority — securing roadmap commitments and engineering capacity from teams outside your reporting line.
Experience owning technical integrations and joint roadmaps with third-party platforms, from design through launch and scaling.
Experience with media quality measurement — invalid traffic and fraud, brand safety and suitability, viewability or attention.
Demonstrated ownership of a product line with meaningful revenue accountability, including packaging and pricing input.
Superior data analysis skills; able to personally derive insight and action from data.
Experience partnering effectively with a distributed engineering organization, including across time zones and cultures.
Excellent written and verbal communication; credible with platform executives, engineers and internal senior leadership alike.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience at an SSP, exchange, ad network, DSP, mobile measurement partner, or curation platform.
Working knowledge of programmatic infrastructure — RTB, OpenRTB signals, supply path optimization, curation, prebid — and of mobile app and CTV supply ecosystems.
Experience with server-side and API-based measurement delivery models rather than tag-based only.
Experience building/developing a high-caliber product team.
Experience participating in or leading industry standards work (e.g. open measurement, IAB or AAO working groups).
Experience building the business operations layer for a growing platform business — usage tracking, rate application, revenue attribution and quote-to-cash.
Hands-on SQL and data analysis capability.
B.S. or higher in Computer Science, a quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.title: Director, Portfolio & Monetization Architecture
jobs.description:
Spotify's growth depends on offering the right thing to the right listener at the right price, moving beyond one-size-fits-all packaging toward a portfolio where listeners can mix and match what they value most. The evolution of our subscription portfolio, and how we monetize it, is one of Spotify’s most important strategic opportunities in the years ahead.

We’re looking for a Director to lead the strategic design of that portfolio end to end, shaping the architecture of tiers, add-ons, bundles, and the broader pricing ecosystem. This role will help define how the portfolio works today and how it evolves over the coming years to better serve listeners while driving sustainable growth.

As the strategic engine behind our portfolio architecture, you’ll combine commercial intuition, consumer understanding, behavioral data, and real-world market signals to build conviction behind critical decisions. Working closely with cross-functional partners and senior leaders, you’ll help determine what belongs in Premium, what moves into new monetization layers, and how Spotify’s subscription offering continues to evolve for millions of listeners around the world.

What You'll Do

Own the architecture of Spotify’s subscription portfolio, including tier structure, add-ons, bundles, and how features are allocated across them.
Set the logic of the price ladder, including relative pricing, upgrade paths, and how regional ladders work across developed and emerging markets.
Drive the insight agenda with Consumer Insights and Analytics, shaping hypotheses, sequencing research, and translating findings into clear portfolio strategy recommendations.
Partner with GTM Enablement and cross-functional teams to design, read, and apply in-market tests that connect consumer research with real behavior.
Build the business case for portfolio decisions, including sizing, contribution logic, trade-offs, and long-term commercial impact.
Drive alignment across Product, Finance, Pricing, Legal, Licensing, and senior leadership on key architecture decisions.
Influence the product roadmap so what gets built reflects willingness-to-pay signals, consumer needs, and portfolio strategy.
Own the multi-year evolution of Spotify’s subscription portfolio, including where the portfolio should sit two-to-three years out and the sequence of moves to get there.

Who You Are

You have deep commercial strategy experience in pricing, packaging, monetization, subscriptions, or consumer businesses.
You think structurally and can reason across an entire packaging-and-pricing system, not just a single product, feature, or number.
You have strong intuition for consumer behavior and behavioral economics, including how people perceive value, compare tiers, and make purchase decisions.
You have a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and building cross-functional consensus without direct authority.
You can move fluently between consumer language and commercial logic, and you are comfortable being the voice of the consumer in strategic discussions.
You have experience with Good-Better-Best architectures, feature gating, add-ons, bundles, or regional price laddering.
You may bring experience from strategy consulting, product strategy, corporate strategy, pricing, consumer tech, media, or subscription businesses.
Familiarity with content or rights licensing, and how it shapes product packaging, would be valuable.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in New York or Stockholm.
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Job Description: Product Management Director - Salesforce Success Plans

About The Team

The Customer Success (CS) Success Plan product management organization is responsible for managing Salesforce’s Customer Success Plan offer portfolio (Standard, Premier, and Signature Success Plans) with which we enable our customers to realize value from their Salesforce technology investments. We work backward from the customer to address their needs across all customer segments (Small Business, Commercial, and Enterprise) and across all Salesforce products. The team is the “voice of the customer and market” to the rest of the CS organization and we work across all functions within CS and the Salesforce product organizations to continuously enhance the customer value and experience delivered by the Success Plans offer portfolio.

About The Role

We're looking for a Product Management Director to build, justify, and operationalize changes to our Success Plans offers. This senior individual contributor (IC) role owns the path from evidence to execution: grounding decisions in customer and stakeholder research, developing and presenting the business cases — financial modeling included — that earn senior leadership alignment, and then owning the operating discipline that keeps those offers accountable once they're live, including feedback loops, performance reporting, and V2MOM updates. You'll also keep a close eye on industry trends, the competitive landscape, and Salesforce's AI roadmap, translating what you see into concrete implications, and drive growth and adoption of the Success Plan offers in market.This senior IC role reports to the Vice President, Product Management for Salesforce Success Plans.

Ideal candidates have deep Salesforce platform knowledge, proven Product Management experience (ideally in Customer Success), a strong record of turning strategy into actionable roadmaps, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Messaging & Communities
jobs.description:
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.

Join us to transform the way the world works.

Job Description

This role will be based in New York, San Francisco, Mountain View, or Bellevue.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

Our mission. Gen Z is entering the workforce at scale and bringing new expectations for how professional relationships begin and grow. They are gravitating toward spaces where people with shared interests can exchange ideas, learn from one another, and build identity and trust over time. Unlike one-way content experiences, communities create an ongoing loop of participation and belonging: every conversation adds context, strengthens relationships, and gives people a reason to return. By bringing together trusted identity, the professional graph, messaging, and global reach, we can create spaces where people return, contribute, and build relationships that move their careers and lives forward.

What this role is: We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to build a new member product at the intersection of messaging and communities. Think of the best parts of modern messaging and community products, rebuilt for the professional world and powered by what makes LinkedIn unique. This is a true zero-to-one role. You will define the vision, find the wedge, validate the core use cases, launch an MVP, and build toward product-market fit. There is no established playbook. We need someone who is excited to write it.

What you’ll do:

You will operate like a founder: close to members, close to the product, and close to the details. You will move from insight to prototype to launch quickly, learn from what works and what does not, and bring engineering, design, data science, research, trust, and operations along with you.
You will bring deep expertise in messaging and communities: how conversations start and persist, why people join and return, and how product mechanics shape participation and belonging. Success is not simply more messages sent. It is healthy, retained communities where members keep showing up and form relationships that matter.

Why are we here:
The best opportunities often come through people: someone who shares your interests, understands what you care about, introduces a new idea, or opens a door you did not know existed. And today, your network is far more fluid than a list of connections. It includes the people you learn from, exchange ideas with, and build relationships with over time in the communities where you belong. Our job is to help every professional find their people; and turn shared interests into relationships that move their work and lives forward

Responsibilities

Define the vision and strategy for a new LinkedIn experience spanning messaging and professional communities.
Discover the strongest member needs, identify the right initial wedge, and turn those insights into a focused roadmap.
Lead the product from concept through prototype, MVP launch, early adoption, and rapid iteration.
Define the core product systems that help people discover, join, participate in, and return to healthy communities.
Establish product-market fit signals centered on retention, repeat participation, community health, and meaningful professional relationships.
Build trust, safety, moderation, and member control into the product and operating model from the beginning.
Make clear trade-offs across member value, quality, speed, safety, and long-term scale.
Align cross-functional teams and senior leaders around the opportunity, priorities, risks, progress, and key decisions.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

BS/BA Degree in a technology related field OR equivalent experience
7+ years of experience in product management or equivalent role

Preferred Qualifications

8+ years of experience in product management or an equivalent role.
5+ years of experience building and scaling high-quality messaging or community products for large and diverse audiences.
Deep product judgment across conversation design, discovery, identity, participation, retention, notifications, trust and safety, moderation, and community health.
A hands-on builder who can move easily between strategy and execution, make decisions with imperfect information, and lead through ambiguity.
Strong technical, analytical, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.

Suggested Skills

AI Fluency
Zero-to-One Product Development
Consumer Product Strategy
Trust, Safety, and Community Health

Description

Amazon operates the world's most complex supply chain — fulfilling global demand for hundreds of millions of products at lighting fast delivery speeds. A core part of making this possible is predicting the future: How much will customers order? How long will new inventory take to arrive? What is the long-term customer impact of changes in availability and delivery speed? And much more.

We address these questions through state-of-the-art machine learning systems that generate hundreds of millions of fine-grained predictions. These forecasts are automatically consumed by systems that order, store, and route inventory — ensuring customers find the products they want, when they need them, and delivered faster than ever. Our work spans the full lifecycle: from foundational research and large-scale experimentation to production deployment and downstream impact measurement.

We need your skills to help us push the boundaries of what's possible. Amazon's SCOT Forecasting team is looking for a Sr. Product Manager-Tech with a proven ability to influence across multiple organizations and drive innovation at scale. In this role, you will define and drive the long-term vision for both established and greenfield forecasting products within an ever-evolving supply chain landscape. You will partner closely with scientists and engineers to build interfaces for state-of-the-art deep learning-based systems that generate the predictions and estimates required to optimize Amazon's supply chain at scale. This role offers a unique opportunity to learn how we bring advanced science — including Deep Learning, Foundation Models, and Large Language Models — out of the lab and into production systems that serve Amazon's worldwide supply chain. And we're focused on doing it faster than ever

You will partner with AWS Service teams to drive roadmap prioritization and incubate new capabilities across professional leagues, collegiate athletics, streaming platforms, studios, and live event venues.

Drawing on familiarity with broadcast and OTT content delivery workflows, venue IoT and edge computing, and fan engagement platforms, you will guide stakeholders through emerging technologies — including generative AI, agentic AI, computer vision, and modern data platforms. Working alongside customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN), we deliver focused guidance through specialty practices spanning a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities

Description

Are you a strategic leader who thrives on ideating and building innovative, dollar-needle-moving campaigns from scratch that reshape how customers adopt GenAI? AWS is seeking a Principal Go-To-Market (GTM) Specialist to own and evolve the worldwide GTM strategy for AI Inference through Amazon SageMaker AI. In this role, you will operate at the intersection of deep technical expertise in distributed inference systems and sharp business judgment to set the strategic direction for SageMaker AI Inference adoption globally. You will identify whitespace opportunities, architect high-impact campaigns that move revenue at scale, and build repeatable mechanisms that the worldwide field organization can execute autonomously. You will operate with minimal context, rapidly synthesizing ambiguous signals from customers, product teams, and market dynamics into clear strategic recommendations absorbable by L10 leaders. You will challenge prevailing assumptions, pressure-test existing motions, and drive team-wide change that raises the bar on how AWS goes to market with AI Inference. You will take your insights from customer engagements and market intelligence to influence service evolution, roadmap prioritization, and long-term product strategy.

Key job responsibilities

You will bring your combined deep technical acumen in clustered computing frameworks/distributed systems and seasoned business judgment to architect the worldwide GTM strategy for Amazon SageMaker AI Inference. You will ideate and build innovative campaigns from scratch—identifying net-new market segments, designing quantified value propositions, and constructing self-service mechanisms that move the revenue needle at scale without requiring your direct involvement in every deal. You will operate as a force multiplier, elevating the productivity and value of Geo-aligned field teams, GenAI Solution Architects, Product Managers, and Marketing Managers by codifying best practices, creating high-leverage enablement frameworks, and mentoring specialists across geos to independently execute complex sales motions.

You will define and own the end-to-end sales motion strategy including customer segmentation frameworks, qualification criteria with quantitative thresholds, positioning of differentiated value through ROI models and competitive battle cards, and scalable mechanisms and campaigns that compress sales cycles. You will challenge existing assumptions about what works—pressure-testing current motions with data, killing underperforming plays, and replacing them with higher-ROI alternatives. You will execute selectively through high-signal direct customer engagements while building the playbooks, tooling, and enablement that empower Geo Data & AI specialists to prospect, develop pipeline, and close business independently worldwide.

As the principal authority on AI Inference GTM, you will synthesize complex technical and market dynamics into crisp, insight-driven narratives absorbable by L10 leaders and VP-level customer stakeholders alike. You will help customers reason through the landscape of AI Inference workloads (spanning agentic, real-time, batch, and traditional ML use cases), evaluate emerging open-source technologies versus native capabilities, and make sound cost/performance/quality trade-off decisions at scale. You will build and present compelling product demos, own the competitive positioning narrative, and handle objections with data-backed conviction from both internal AWS teams and external customers. You will architect the customer evidence flywheel—securing quotes, cultivating public references, and partnering with Marketing to build case studies that become self-sustaining demand generators. You will synthesize insights from outbound engagements, competitive intelligence, and market trends into written recommendations that directly influence service roadmap prioritization and long-term product strategy for AI Inference.

A day in the life

You will design and deliver enablement programs that make field teams self-sufficient, reducing dependency on central specialists. You will lead customer-facing webinars and represent SageMaker AI Inference at flagship AWS events. You will write crisp, insight-rich documents—product feedback memos backed by customer evidence, market landscape analyses, and strategic recommendations—that directly shape roadmap decisions in sessions with product leadership. You will proactively identify and drive team-wide improvements: new mechanisms, process changes, or strategic pivots that raise the bar for the entire GTM organization.

Owns the strategic direction and overall business performance of assigned aerospace product lines, including market strategy, pricing, portfolio management, and profitability. Leads and develops a team of product management professionals while driving cross-functional initiatives to expand market share, increase revenue and strengthen profitability across manufacturing sites. Description

As customers accelerate their move to the cloud, migration and modernization assessments are becoming the critical first step on the path to an agentic future. AWS is looking for a Product Manager to own and grow the Optimization and Licensing Assessment (OLA) program — a portfolio of assessment offerings spanning Microsoft, Database, Storage, and more. You will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution that keep the program delivering against its targets, setting annual goals, defining what success looks like, and steering the program as conditions change.

A core part of this role is turning data into decisions. You will use analytical tools to build and maintain tracking and reporting that gives the business visibility into assessment volume, pipeline, engagement, and delivery performance, then translate those insights into clear business recommendations on where to invest, what to prioritize, and how to course-correct. You will own forecasting so leadership has a reliable forward view for resourcing and planning. Beyond internal execution, you will manage the third-party vendor and partner relationships OLA depends on — covering roadmap alignment, incentive structures, invoicing, and commercial coordination — while partnering closely with sellers, partners, and customers to shape licensing and assessment strategies.

Key job responsibilities

Define and execute the OLA program strategy, owning the roadmap, annual goals, and delivery targets across multiple assessment offerings while identifying and negotiating complex partner and vendor deals.
Build and maintain reporting dashboards and forecasting models, interpreting data from analytical tools to surface actionable business recommendations that guide program investment and priorities.
Manage the lifecycle of third-party vendor and consulting partner relationships, including roadmap alignment, incentive design, invoicing, and commercial coordination.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Service teams, Field teams, and aligned Program teams to represent the OLA program in go-to-market strategy and contribute to planning documents.
Gather and synthesize customer and partner feedback to inform product feature requests and future road-mapping decisions, working directly with product and engineering organizations.

A day in the life

You might start the morning reviewing OLA pipeline dashboards, checking how assessment volume and delivery are tracking against plan and flagging items that need attention. Mid-morning could bring a working session where you build a new reporting query or refine a forecast for an upcoming leadership review. After lunch you join a cross-team strategy discussion with Product Marketing and Field stakeholders, then shift to a vendor check-in on incentive alignment. Later in the afternoon you use AI tools to prototype an automation that streamlines a manual reporting workflow, wrapping up with partner coordination that keeps the program moving forward.

About The Team

This role sits within the AWS Infrastructure Migration and Modernization team, part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Our mission is to help customers use data to make informed migration decisions and receive optimization recommendations that set them on the path to an agentic future. You will have access to AI tools to build automation and agents, giving you hands-on opportunities to grow new technical skills alongside your business expertise.

Specialists on the team own the go-to-market strategy for their technology domains, while Partner teams drive the recruiting, development, and growth of key consulting and technology partners. Together, we give customers the expertise and scale they need to tackle their most complex challenges.

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

jobs.description:
Overview

Search Platform is the retrieval and grounding foundation for Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents. Our shared services turn Microsoft 365 knowledge into trusted, permission-aware evidence through indexing, retrieval and ranking, and grounding. Product teams across Microsoft consume them through Microsoft Graph and Work IQ, and relevance teams ship quality on top of them. Every Copilot answer, search result, and agent action is only as good as the evidence behind it, so our job is to make every quality gain land faster, cheaper, and everywhere, and to prove it with data everyone trusts.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager on the Enterprise Search and Grounding Platform team to drive strategy and execution to deliver Copilot and Agents quality gains.

This position is based in Redmond, Washington and requires the employee be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

The strategy

Define the vision, multi-year roadmap, and success metrics for the Developer Experience pillar, anchored on the Search Platform north star: one trusted platform, tuned by scenario, with recall-forward, low-latency retrieval for agents.
Own product definition for the developer-facing API surface, including the next major version of our core retrieval API and the Work IQ and Retrieval API integration patterns, with a bias toward stable, scenario-agnostic contracts that outlive any single experience.
Decide what the platform should offer as a shared capability and what stays with individual agent teams, and drive the consolidation of bespoke integrations onto supported patterns.

Make the platform easy to build on

Design the onboarding path for a new agent team, from first call to production: reference integrations, documentation, samples, and self-serve tooling that remove the need for a bespoke engagement.
Treat debuggability as a product requirement. Specify the observability, tracing, and diagnostics developers need to understand why a query returned what it did and to fix issues without escalating to the platform team.
Translate agent needs into platform requirements for recall, latency budgets, and evidence formats, working with the Quality Improvements and Frontier Platform Innovation pillars so that recall-forward retrieval tuned for agents ships as part of the core platform.

Lead across the organization

Author crisp specs, requirements documents, and program plans; drive execution across multiple engineering teams and owners; and communicate status, risks, and trade-offs clearly to leadership.
Represent Search Platform developer experience with senior stakeholders across Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Graph, Work IQ, and partner organizations, landing decisions and aligning roadmaps.
Raise the bar for platform product management on the team by mentoring PMs and modeling data-driven, customer-obsessed decision making.

Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development
OR equivalent experience.

Microsoft Cloud Background Check:
This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Significant experience shipping developer-facing platforms, APIs, or SDKs consumed by other engineering teams, including ownership of API design, versioning, and deprecation decisions.
Demonstrated ability to define a platform strategy and land it across organizational boundaries, influencing senior engineering and product leaders without direct authority.
Technical depth: comfortable with distributed systems and the trade-offs among latency, throughput, and cost, and able to engage credibly with senior engineers in design reviews.
Track record of turning customer and developer feedback into prioritized roadmaps and measurable outcomes.
Communicate with clear, narratives and actionable specifications to executive-level audience.
Experience with search, information retrieval, retrieval-augmented generation, grounding, or LLM-based agent platforms.

Experience defining observability and diagnostics as a product surface, or operating platform scorecards and metrics.
Prior experience as a software engineer.

Microsoft Commerce is placing large bets across Consumer, Merchant, Partner, and Payments in a market being reshaped by agentic commerce and a live contest over the protocols and payer models that will govern it.

This is an individual-contributor force-multiplier to the VP. The role sets net-new strategic direction that the pillar teams build against, holds the entire Commerce picture at once, and reaches a defensible call: what we bet on, who pays and why, how big the prize is, and the story that carries it through review. The ideal candidate reasons from first principles about business models and market opportunity, brings structure to high-stakes product decisions, and turns dense analysis into one clear, defensible narrative. Leverage comes from the quality of the thinking and the clarity of the call rather than the size of a team.

In this role you will own strategy across the full Commerce portfolio, including:

Market & competitive strategy: a first-principles POV on agentic commerce — the protocol landscape, the incentives of each major player, and where our advantage is real.
Monetization & business-model design: who pays and why across Consumer, Merchant, and Partner; payer models, methods, and sequencing that give the strategy a working economic engine.
Opportunity sizing & forecasting: market, feature, and monetization sizing from first principles — TAM → SAM → capturable, unit economics, ARR and ROI.
Decision frameworks for major bets: structure for high-stakes, ambiguous calls — build / buy / partner, sequencing, reversible vs. one-way-door, and where to place a bet across pillars.
Cross-thread synthesis: one coherent strategy across Consumer, Merchant, Partner, and Payments, with the conflicts surfaced before they collide in review.
Narrative & decision support: the strategy spine — MMM narrative, FY strategy papers, the investment case — written to land with senior stakeholders.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.

Responsibilities

Own a current, first-principles POV on the agentic-commerce market, the protocol landscape (for example ACP, UCP, AP2, MCP), and where Microsoft’s advantage is real.
Design and pressure-test monetization: the payer model across Consumer, Merchant, and Partner, the methods, and the sequencing.
Build the opportunity models and forecasts that let the org rank bets and defend investment asks with numbers, including ARR- and ROI-based justification.
Bring repeatable decision frameworks to major product bets so the reasoning is structured and legible.
Synthesize the Consumer, Merchant, Partner, and Payments threads into one coherent strategy and surface where they conflict.
Turn the analysis into the strategy spine — the MMM narrative, FY strategy papers, and investment cases — and prep the VP with a sharp POV and the two or three things that would change it.
Operate as a peer to senior leaders: form a POV, defend it, and change it on evidence.

Amazon Devices – the team behind the best-selling Amazon Echo, Alexa, Kindle E-reader, Fire Tablet, Fire TV, Cloud Cam and Dash Button product lines—is seeking a seasoned product manager to join the Devices Pricing and Promotions team to help lead our pricing strategy and systems.

We are an interdisciplinary team that combines the talents of science and engineering to develop and deliver solutions that measurably achieve this goal.

We are looking for an experienced Sr Product Manager - Technical to tackle complex and ambiguous marketing optimization and automation problems that span numerous systems and organizations across the Devices business (Echo Device Family, FireTV, eReaders, Tablets etc.). jobs.description:
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.

Join us to transform the way the world works.

Job Description

This role will be based in San Francisco, Mountain View, Bellevue, or remote.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. This role may be remote or hybrid. At LinkedIn, hybrid roles are performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team. Remote roles are performed from the designated home work location upon time of hire, and any changes to this home work location requires a review of remote status and approval.

What this role is

This role is about one thing: creating specialized agents that are genuinely good at a specific job.
You will own agents built for roles like sales, recruiting, or business operations. That means understanding the actual work, the actual handoffs, and the actual measure of a good day in that role, then designing backward from there.

What you will own

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager (Tech), SCOT-AIM
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon’s SCOT-BizOps AI team is looking for an experienced Sr Product Manager (Tech) to conceptualize, articulate, and develop state of the art technology to measure and improve the shopping experience of every Amazon customer. The BizOps-AI team is a part of Amazon’s Supply Chain Optimization Technology (SCOT) organization, whose charter is to deliver the best possible customer experience and improve supply chain outcomes while maximizing the return on our inventory investment, fulfillment assets, and transportation network. We are never satisfied with the status quo and are convinced that there is always opportunity to innovate on behalf of customers.

Unlike brick and mortar stores where it is challenging to capture customer interest in a product unless they actually purchase the item, e-commerce offers the unique advantage of capturing customer "glance views" even if they don't convert to sales. Glance views, or GVs, are a leading indicator of potential future demand and allow us to capture a comprehensive set of data points (eg. price, delivery speed) to understand what we showed the customer and the resultant customer behavior. Amazon uses GV data to metricize and improve key performance indicators for customer experience like availability and promised delivery speed.

The person in this role will own Tier-1 CX and Supply chain metrics that provide stakeholders across Amazon with deep insights to identify and resolve defects. These metrics answer questions like: Was Amazon in stock on an item when customers were viewing it? Was the inventory in a location from where it could be immediately picked, packed, and shipped out to the customer? If not, what was the root cause? Your products will simplify the Business operations associated with these metrics, right from extracting insights from data, identifying opportunities for improvement, working with partner teams to deliver automated and scalable solutions, and providing regular performance/progress updates to stakeholders. You will build AI-powered solutions to automate repetitive tasks such as insight generation, identifying defects, debugging issues, developing/improving solutions for new use-cases and deploying fixes in production. This will involve managing the data infrastructure, software applications and CX interfaces.

The products you build will have a worldwide user base, spanning across multiple organizations that play a role in Amazon’s supply chain and the shopping experience we deliver to customer. You will own the process of first understanding what information is valuable to our internal customers and then working closely with our business intelligence, data engineering, and research science teams to deliver products that meet our customers’ needs in the long term. You will always be challenged to think several steps ahead so that the solutions you are building today will scale well with future growth and without adding excessive operational overhead. You will help define the product roadmap, serve as the voice of the customer, and champion your products across Amazon. You will work with worldwide retail category and supply chain operations teams, in-house scientists, other product managers, and software teams to define new features and products. You will analyze the potential customer and financial impacts, select the most promising ideas, prioritize them, and create a cohesive roadmap that makes the best use of available resources. You will also evangelize new features to our internal customers, working to accelerate feature adoption, track the realized impacts, and communicate results with senior leadership.

This is a highly visible role and will require regular interaction and communication with senior leaders. You must have the experience and capability to prepare documentation for senior executives and align your roadmap with Amazon’s strategic objectives. Excellent written and verbal communication skills are a necessity. Successful candidates should excel at diving into data in order to analyze problems and implement simple, long term solutions. You will have the opportunity to thrive in a highly collaborative, creative, analytical, and fast-paced environment oriented around building the world’s most flexible and effective supply chain management technology.

Key job responsibilities

Work with internal customers to understand their use cases and their existing solutions. Drive requirements definition, UI design, feature development priority, and product adoption/effectiveness.
Collaborate with your engineering and business teams to drive the product roadmaps.
Define product strategy and vision, and own the product roadmap and related literature.
Address bottlenecks, identify inefficiencies, anticipate and make tradeoffs; balance the business and customers’ needs versus technical constraints.
Own production of business metrics for Availability data-products- detecting anomalies, deep long-term trends and insight generation.
Lead technical product development for new strategic initiatives.
Own Business Requirement Documents, User Stories, Use Cases, and Product Strategy documents.
Evaluate technical solutions with alternatives and decompose significantly complex problems into concise and effective technical propositions.
Partner with multiple tech and product teams across multiple locations with varying sets of priorities to ensure a timely delivery of the solution.

Amazon's Intermodal (AZIM) Network Optimization team is looking for a Senior Product Manager to drive the technology and product strategy that powers cost optimization and operational efficiency across the intermodal network, with a primary focus on drayage. This is a high-impact role responsible for translating complex supply chain problems — drayage cost reduction, carrier allocation, load planning, and ramp-level execution — into scalable product and automation solutions.

This role will own the product roadmap for drayage optimization tooling, partnering closely with engineering, operations, finance, and sourcing teams to define requirements, prioritize investments, and deliver capabilities that measurably reduce cost and manual effort. The ideal candidate combines strong technical product management skills with supply chain fluency, is comfortable navigating ambiguity to define what should be built and why, and thrives in a fast-paced environment where shipping product improvements directly impacts network economics.

Key job responsibilities

Drayage Product Strategy & Roadmap Own the product vision and roadmap for drayage optimization — including carrier allocation, load planning, cost modeling, and ramp-level execution tooling. Define what to build, sequence investments, and align stakeholders on priorities.

Requirements & Solution Design Translate operational pain points and cost reduction opportunities into clear product requirements and technical specifications. Partner with engineering to scope solutions that balance speed-to-value with long-term scalability.

Automation & Tooling Development Identify and eliminate manual processes across the drayage lifecycle by designing automated workflows, alerting mechanisms, and self-service analytics capabilities that reduce toil and improve decision speed.

Data & Metrics Ownership Define and instrument success metrics for drayage product initiatives. Monitor adoption, measure realized cost savings, and use data to iterate on product direction and prioritize the backlog.

Description

Alexa Japan Product owns the Alexa+ experience for customers in Japan. We work closely with product, engineering, applied science, business development, and marketing teams across Amazon to make sure Alexa+ works even better for Japan than it does in any other locale. The decisions you make will reach millions of customers across Japan.

Alexa+ is the next generation of Alexa, rebuilt on large language models. We are bringing it to customers in Japan, and this is a rare opportunity to shape how a world-class AI assistant works in one of the most demanding and quality-conscious markets.

We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager to own a core part of the Alexa+ experience in Japan. You will own the roadmap for your product area, decide what needs to be built and in what order, and hold the bar for what a good experience looks like for Japanese customers.

Part of holding that bar is defining it: you will build the test cases that specify how the product should behave across the range of things Japanese customers ask for. When something does not work, you will dig into it yourself — reproduce the issue, narrow down where it breaks, and work with engineers and scientists to scope the fix.

You will spend time on which problems are worth solving, how to solve them, and what is needed to convince the right stakeholders to invest. This role suits someone who is comfortable with ambiguity, fluent enough technically to hold their own in a design review, and native in Japanese. You do not need a background in linguistics or machine learning research. You do need strong product judgment and the willingness to get into technical and linguistic details.

Key job responsibilities

Own the product roadmap and requirements for your area. Define the customer experience, write the specs and PR/FAQs, and set the success metrics.
Design the acceptance tests that define the product. Build the taxonomy of use cases and utterances your area has to support, write the seed test cases yourself, then use AI tooling to expand them into the hundreds or thousands of cases needed to prove the experience holds up.
Prioritize ruthlessly. Decide what absolutely needs to be built, what can be cut, and which quality bars are non-negotiable. Make the trade-offs between time, effort, and scope explicit.
Investigate product defects and quality issues. Reproduce them, isolate root cause with engineering and science partners, and turn findings into scoped, prioritized work.
Partner day-to-day with engineering, applied science, and marketing teams. Translate customer needs into technical requirements and align stakeholders on the plan.
Represent the Japanese customer. Use your own judgment of the language and cultural context to catch problems that metrics alone will not surface.
Define the KPIs for your area, own launch readiness including go/no-go criteria, and report progress, risks, and decisions to senior leadership.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with end to end product delivery
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
5+ years of technical product management, program management or engineering experience
Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese at a business level or above (N1+)
Experience investigating product defects and quality issues and driving them to resolution with engineers

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality
Master's degree or above in an advanced technical degree field
Experience selling AI/ML solutions
Experience managing and delivering product quality or testing
Experience with competitive benchmarking and turning the findings into product requirements

new_jobs.title: Sr. Director of Product Management - DV Marketplace Suite
new_jobs.description:
Company Overview

Founded in 2008, DoubleVerify (DV) is the leading independent provider of marketing measurement software, data and analytics that authenticates the quality and effectiveness of digital media for the world's largest brands and media platforms. DV provides media transparency and accountability to deliver the highest level of impression quality for maximum advertising performance by bringing transparency and accountability to the market and ensuring ad viewability, brand safety, fraud protection, accurate impression delivery and audience quality across campaigns to drive performance. DV has helped hundreds of Fortune 500 companies across every major vertical, including financial services, telecom, automotive, retail, CPG, travel, luxury and pharmaceuticals gain the most value out of their media spend by delivering best-in-class solutions across the digital ecosystem. Let's build a better industry.

Position Overview

The Sr. Director, Product Management — DV Marketplace Suite owns the product vision, strategy, roadmap and delivery for DVMS: DoubleVerify's solution for protecting and optimizing programmatic marketplaces. DVMS provides fraud/IVT protection, brand suitability and viewability measurement across desktop, mobile web, mobile app and CTV, helping platforms, exchanges and publishers ensure marketplace inventory is human, viewable and brand-safe. It is one of DV's fastest-growing businesses.

Your customers are the marketplaces themselves — SSPs, exchanges, ad networks and DSPs — who license DV's measurement and pre-bid capabilities to differentiate their supply to buyers. That makes this a distinctive product challenge: you are building for users who work inside someone else's platform, on someone else's release cycle, under commercial terms negotiated partner by partner. Success depends as much on integration design, packaging and partner economics as it does on features.

The role is highly cross-functional by design. DVMS is powered by capabilities that span the company — fraud detection, brand suitability, viewability, attention, pre-bid segment infrastructure, measurement tag foundations and data delivery. Turning that breadth into a coherent marketplace product, and building the partnerships across DV needed to deliver it, is the core of the job. This is a role for someone who excels at collaboration, relationship-building and ideating creative solutions.

You will lead a small, senior product team and be accountable for product strategy and execution that drives revenue growth: extending measurement into new quality dimensions, deepening supply-path and inventory-quality insight, bringing attention measurement to new marketplaces, leveraging AI-powered innovation, and expanding DV's reach across the programmatic ecosystem. You will set the strategy that keeps DVMS the market leader in a fast-moving and competitive category.

Job Responsibilities

Own and be accountable for the DVMS product vision, strategy, roadmap and revenue outcomes across the DV Marketplace Suite portfolio.
Lead, coach and grow a team of Product Managers; set the standard for discovery, prioritization and cross-organizational execution, and develop the next generation of product leaders on the team.
Grow the business through new and existing products — new invalid-traffic and quality measurement dimensions, supply path and inventory quality insights, attention measurement for marketplaces, and partner programs that extend reach into emerging and mid-tail supply.
Maintain a clear, evidence-based view of the competitive landscape and ensure DVMS stays ahead of it across fraud, quality and supply transparency.
Build and sustain the cross-functional partnerships DVMS delivery depends on — securing clear commitments and a durable operating rhythm with the programmatic, measurement, classification, fraud and platform infrastructure teams whose capabilities power the suite.
Develop deep understanding of how SSPs, exchanges, ad networks and DSPs operate, monetize, and evaluate a measurement partner — and design DV's products to fit those realities.
Partner with Business Development and Platform Sales on pricing, packaging, contracting and revenue attribution for platform deals; support commercial teams in closing and expanding platform partnerships.
Own the product side of major marketplace partner relationships, including technical integration design, joint roadmap alignment, and executive-level partner reviews; partner with DV's Integrations organization on turnkey and custom integrations.
Own the product direction for the DVMS partner-facing interface and reporting experience.
Drive delivery velocity in close partnership with the dedicated DVMS engineering organization; establish clear requirements, make explicit prioritization decisions, and manage scope.
Partner with Product Marketing, Product Analytics, Revenue Operations and Finance on the business operations layer behind the product — usage tracking, rate application, product-level revenue attribution and product health reporting.
Represent DV in industry standards bodies and working groups relevant to supply-side and open measurement, and at industry events.

Minimum Qualifications

10+ years of total professional experience, including 7+ years in Product Management.
2+ years of people management experience with Product Managers as direct reports.
4+ years of product experience in the advertising technology ecosystem, with direct exposure to the marketplace side — SSPs, exchanges, ad networks, DSPs, or platform-side measurement and data integrations.
Demonstrated success delivering products through influence rather than direct authority — securing roadmap commitments and engineering capacity from teams outside your reporting line.
Experience owning technical integrations and joint roadmaps with third-party platforms, from design through launch and scaling.
Experience with media quality measurement — invalid traffic and fraud, brand safety and suitability, viewability or attention.
Demonstrated ownership of a product line with meaningful revenue accountability, including packaging and pricing input.
Superior data analysis skills; able to personally derive insight and action from data.
Experience partnering effectively with a distributed engineering organization, including across time zones and cultures.
Excellent written and verbal communication; credible with platform executives, engineers and internal senior leadership alike.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience at an SSP, exchange, ad network, DSP, mobile measurement partner, or curation platform.
Working knowledge of programmatic infrastructure — RTB, OpenRTB signals, supply path optimization, curation, prebid — and of mobile app and CTV supply ecosystems.
Experience with server-side and API-based measurement delivery models rather than tag-based only.
Experience building/developing a high-caliber product team.
Experience participating in or leading industry standards work (e.g. open measurement, IAB or AAO working groups).
Experience building the business operations layer for a growing platform business — usage tracking, rate application, revenue attribution and quote-to-cash.
Hands-on SQL and data analysis capability.
B.S. or higher in Computer Science, a quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

new_jobs.title: Director, Portfolio & Monetization Architecture
new_jobs.description:
Spotify's growth depends on offering the right thing to the right listener at the right price, moving beyond one-size-fits-all packaging toward a portfolio where listeners can mix and match what they value most. The evolution of our subscription portfolio, and how we monetize it, is one of Spotify’s most important strategic opportunities in the years ahead.

We’re looking for a Director to lead the strategic design of that portfolio end to end, shaping the architecture of tiers, add-ons, bundles, and the broader pricing ecosystem. This role will help define how the portfolio works today and how it evolves over the coming years to better serve listeners while driving sustainable growth.

As the strategic engine behind our portfolio architecture, you’ll combine commercial intuition, consumer understanding, behavioral data, and real-world market signals to build conviction behind critical decisions. Working closely with cross-functional partners and senior leaders, you’ll help determine what belongs in Premium, what moves into new monetization layers, and how Spotify’s subscription offering continues to evolve for millions of listeners around the world.

What You'll Do

Own the architecture of Spotify’s subscription portfolio, including tier structure, add-ons, bundles, and how features are allocated across them.
Set the logic of the price ladder, including relative pricing, upgrade paths, and how regional ladders work across developed and emerging markets.
Drive the insight agenda with Consumer Insights and Analytics, shaping hypotheses, sequencing research, and translating findings into clear portfolio strategy recommendations.
Partner with GTM Enablement and cross-functional teams to design, read, and apply in-market tests that connect consumer research with real behavior.
Build the business case for portfolio decisions, including sizing, contribution logic, trade-offs, and long-term commercial impact.
Drive alignment across Product, Finance, Pricing, Legal, Licensing, and senior leadership on key architecture decisions.
Influence the product roadmap so what gets built reflects willingness-to-pay signals, consumer needs, and portfolio strategy.
Own the multi-year evolution of Spotify’s subscription portfolio, including where the portfolio should sit two-to-three years out and the sequence of moves to get there.

Who You Are

You have deep commercial strategy experience in pricing, packaging, monetization, subscriptions, or consumer businesses.
You think structurally and can reason across an entire packaging-and-pricing system, not just a single product, feature, or number.
You have strong intuition for consumer behavior and behavioral economics, including how people perceive value, compare tiers, and make purchase decisions.
You have a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and building cross-functional consensus without direct authority.
You can move fluently between consumer language and commercial logic, and you are comfortable being the voice of the consumer in strategic discussions.
You have experience with Good-Better-Best architectures, feature gating, add-ons, bundles, or regional price laddering.
You may bring experience from strategy consulting, product strategy, corporate strategy, pricing, consumer tech, media, or subscription businesses.
Familiarity with content or rights licensing, and how it shapes product packaging, would be valuable.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in New York or Stockholm.
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Job Description: Product Management Director - Salesforce Success Plans

About The Team

The Customer Success (CS) Success Plan product management organization is responsible for managing Salesforce’s Customer Success Plan offer portfolio (Standard, Premier, and Signature Success Plans) with which we enable our customers to realize value from their Salesforce technology investments. We work backward from the customer to address their needs across all customer segments (Small Business, Commercial, and Enterprise) and across all Salesforce products. The team is the “voice of the customer and market” to the rest of the CS organization and we work across all functions within CS and the Salesforce product organizations to continuously enhance the customer value and experience delivered by the Success Plans offer portfolio.

About The Role

We're looking for a Product Management Director to build, justify, and operationalize changes to our Success Plans offers. This senior individual contributor (IC) role owns the path from evidence to execution: grounding decisions in customer and stakeholder research, developing and presenting the business cases — financial modeling included — that earn senior leadership alignment, and then owning the operating discipline that keeps those offers accountable once they're live, including feedback loops, performance reporting, and V2MOM updates. You'll also keep a close eye on industry trends, the competitive landscape, and Salesforce's AI roadmap, translating what you see into concrete implications, and drive growth and adoption of the Success Plan offers in market.This senior IC role reports to the Vice President, Product Management for Salesforce Success Plans.

Ideal candidates have deep Salesforce platform knowledge, proven Product Management experience (ideally in Customer Success), a strong record of turning strategy into actionable roadmaps, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.

What You'll Do

Conduct customer and stakeholder research to understand needs, analyze feedback, and drive innovation.
Act as a thought leader and craft clear, concise and unbiased point of view documents on necessary changes to features, the portfolio, and the go-to-market (GTM) model.
Develop and present business cases for new offers or enhancements, including financial modeling, and secure senior leadership alignment.
Drive growth and adoption of the Success Plan offers
Own the operating rhythm behind the offer: feedback loops, offer performance reporting, and V2MOM updates, so the team stays accountable to its goals.
Stay ahead of industry trends, the competitive landscape, and Salesforce's own AI roadmap so you can proactively flag implications to Success Plans

Ideal Candidate Profile

Deep Salesforce Knowledge: You have a strong working knowledge of Salesforce products and a keen understanding of how enterprise software companies go to market.
