new_jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Messaging & Communities
new_jobs.description:
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.

Join us to transform the way the world works.

Job Description

This role will be based in New York, San Francisco, Mountain View, or Bellevue.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

Our mission. Gen Z is entering the workforce at scale and bringing new expectations for how professional relationships begin and grow. They are gravitating toward spaces where people with shared interests can exchange ideas, learn from one another, and build identity and trust over time. Unlike one-way content experiences, communities create an ongoing loop of participation and belonging: every conversation adds context, strengthens relationships, and gives people a reason to return. By bringing together trusted identity, the professional graph, messaging, and global reach, we can create spaces where people return, contribute, and build relationships that move their careers and lives forward.

What this role is: We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to build a new member product at the intersection of messaging and communities. Think of the best parts of modern messaging and community products, rebuilt for the professional world and powered by what makes LinkedIn unique. This is a true zero-to-one role. You will define the vision, find the wedge, validate the core use cases, launch an MVP, and build toward product-market fit. There is no established playbook. We need someone who is excited to write it.

What you’ll do:

You will operate like a founder: close to members, close to the product, and close to the details. You will move from insight to prototype to launch quickly, learn from what works and what does not, and bring engineering, design, data science, research, trust, and operations along with you.
You will bring deep expertise in messaging and communities: how conversations start and persist, why people join and return, and how product mechanics shape participation and belonging. Success is not simply more messages sent. It is healthy, retained communities where members keep showing up and form relationships that matter.

Why are we here:
The best opportunities often come through people: someone who shares your interests, understands what you care about, introduces a new idea, or opens a door you did not know existed. And today, your network is far more fluid than a list of connections. It includes the people you learn from, exchange ideas with, and build relationships with over time in the communities where you belong. Our job is to help every professional find their people; and turn shared interests into relationships that move their work and lives forward

Responsibilities

Define the vision and strategy for a new LinkedIn experience spanning messaging and professional communities.
Discover the strongest member needs, identify the right initial wedge, and turn those insights into a focused roadmap.
Lead the product from concept through prototype, MVP launch, early adoption, and rapid iteration.
Define the core product systems that help people discover, join, participate in, and return to healthy communities.
Establish product-market fit signals centered on retention, repeat participation, community health, and meaningful professional relationships.
Build trust, safety, moderation, and member control into the product and operating model from the beginning.
Make clear trade-offs across member value, quality, speed, safety, and long-term scale.
Align cross-functional teams and senior leaders around the opportunity, priorities, risks, progress, and key decisions.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

BS/BA Degree in a technology related field OR equivalent experience
7+ years of experience in product management or equivalent role

Preferred Qualifications

8+ years of experience in product management or an equivalent role.
5+ years of experience building and scaling high-quality messaging or community products for large and diverse audiences.
Deep product judgment across conversation design, discovery, identity, participation, retention, notifications, trust and safety, moderation, and community health.
A hands-on builder who can move easily between strategy and execution, make decisions with imperfect information, and lead through ambiguity.
Strong technical, analytical, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.

Suggested Skills

AI Fluency
Zero-to-One Product Development
Consumer Product Strategy
Trust, Safety, and Community Health

Description

Amazon operates the world's most complex supply chain — fulfilling global demand for hundreds of millions of products at lighting fast delivery speeds. A core part of making this possible is predicting the future: How much will customers order? How long will new inventory take to arrive? What is the long-term customer impact of changes in availability and delivery speed? And much more.

We address these questions through state-of-the-art machine learning systems that generate hundreds of millions of fine-grained predictions. These forecasts are automatically consumed by systems that order, store, and route inventory — ensuring customers find the products they want, when they need them, and delivered faster than ever. Our work spans the full lifecycle: from foundational research and large-scale experimentation to production deployment and downstream impact measurement.

We need your skills to help us push the boundaries of what's possible. Amazon's SCOT Forecasting team is looking for a Sr. Product Manager-Tech with a proven ability to influence across multiple organizations and drive innovation at scale. In this role, you will define and drive the long-term vision for both established and greenfield forecasting products within an ever-evolving supply chain landscape. You will partner closely with scientists and engineers to build interfaces for state-of-the-art deep learning-based systems that generate the predictions and estimates required to optimize Amazon's supply chain at scale. This role offers a unique opportunity to learn how we bring advanced science — including Deep Learning, Foundation Models, and Large Language Models — out of the lab and into production systems that serve Amazon's worldwide supply chain. And we're focused on doing it faster than ever

Working backwards from customer problems to define the 3-5 year vision for Forecasting products, and working with scientists and engineering to achieve that vision

Drawing on familiarity with broadcast and OTT content delivery workflows, venue IoT and edge computing, and fan engagement platforms, you will guide stakeholders through emerging technologies — including generative AI, agentic AI, computer vision, and modern data platforms. You will identify patterns across customers, develop new architectural principles, and create reusable intellectual property that drives innovation at scale, while managing up to four concurrent engagements.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that helps customers realize their desired business outcomes on the AWS Cloud. Working alongside customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN), we deliver focused guidance through specialty practices spanning a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities

Owning the full engagement lifecycle for Sports, Media, and Entertainment customers: leading discovery sessions, defining target-state architectures, building proof-of-concept solutions, designing and implementing production-grade cloud solutions, and ensuring adherence to Well-Architected best practices

Building and deploying AI/ML solutions including ML training and inference pipelines, RAG architectures with prompt engineering, agentic workflow orchestration, and media processing workflows for industry use cases such as fan engagement, venue operations, content workflows, and media production

Designing and implementing data platform solutions using lakehouse and medallion architectures, streaming pipelines, and open table formats to support analytics and AI workloads for sports and media customers

Building reusable architectural artifacts, developing new design patterns by identifying trends across the vertical, and partnering with AWS Service teams on roadmap priorities

Mentoring team members, leading knowledge-sharing initiatives, and contributing to the practice's emerging technology roadmap to grow organizational capabilities

At lunch, you mentor teammates on computer vision for venue operations. Afternoon shifts to presenting a business case to C-level executives at an MLS club, securing a funded engagement.

Late afternoon, you collaborate with AWS Service teams on roadmap priorities, then finalize a reusable reference architecture for the vertical. You close the day reviewing portfolio metrics and drafting strategic recommendations for senior leadership.

Work/Life Balance: We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Description

Are you a strategic leader who thrives on ideating and building innovative, dollar-needle-moving campaigns from scratch that reshape how customers adopt GenAI? AWS is seeking a Principal Go-To-Market (GTM) Specialist to own and evolve the worldwide GTM strategy for AI Inference through Amazon SageMaker AI. In this role, you will operate at the intersection of deep technical expertise in distributed inference systems and sharp business judgment to set the strategic direction for SageMaker AI Inference adoption globally. You will identify whitespace opportunities, architect high-impact campaigns that move revenue at scale, and build repeatable mechanisms that the worldwide field organization can execute autonomously. You will operate with minimal context, rapidly synthesizing ambiguous signals from customers, product teams, and market dynamics into clear strategic recommendations absorbable by L10 leaders. You will challenge prevailing assumptions, pressure-test existing motions, and drive team-wide change that raises the bar on how AWS goes to market with AI Inference. You will take your insights from customer engagements and market intelligence to influence service evolution, roadmap prioritization, and long-term product strategy.

Key job responsibilities

You will bring your combined deep technical acumen in clustered computing frameworks/distributed systems and seasoned business judgment to architect the worldwide GTM strategy for Amazon SageMaker AI Inference. You will ideate and build innovative campaigns from scratch—identifying net-new market segments, designing quantified value propositions, and constructing self-service mechanisms that move the revenue needle at scale without requiring your direct involvement in every deal. You will operate as a force multiplier, elevating the productivity and value of Geo-aligned field teams, GenAI Solution Architects, Product Managers, and Marketing Managers by codifying best practices, creating high-leverage enablement frameworks, and mentoring specialists across geos to independently execute complex sales motions.

You will define and own the end-to-end sales motion strategy including customer segmentation frameworks, qualification criteria with quantitative thresholds, positioning of differentiated value through ROI models and competitive battle cards, and scalable mechanisms and campaigns that compress sales cycles. You will challenge existing assumptions about what works—pressure-testing current motions with data, killing underperforming plays, and replacing them with higher-ROI alternatives. You will execute selectively through high-signal direct customer engagements while building the playbooks, tooling, and enablement that empower Geo Data & AI specialists to prospect, develop pipeline, and close business independently worldwide.

As the principal authority on AI Inference GTM, you will synthesize complex technical and market dynamics into crisp, insight-driven narratives absorbable by L10 leaders and VP-level customer stakeholders alike. You will help customers reason through the landscape of AI Inference workloads (spanning agentic, real-time, batch, and traditional ML use cases), evaluate emerging open-source technologies versus native capabilities, and make sound cost/performance/quality trade-off decisions at scale. You will build and present compelling product demos, own the competitive positioning narrative, and handle objections with data-backed conviction from both internal AWS teams and external customers. You will architect the customer evidence flywheel—securing quotes, cultivating public references, and partnering with Marketing to build case studies that become self-sustaining demand generators. You will synthesize insights from outbound engagements, competitive intelligence, and market trends into written recommendations that directly influence service roadmap prioritization and long-term product strategy for AI Inference.

A day in the life

As the principal owner of a critical segment of the SageMaker AI business worldwide, you will context-switch fluidly across strategic and executional activities: You will analyze propensity models and market signals to identify the highest-leverage customer cohorts, then work with field leaders to architect engagement strategies that open doors to VP/C-level AI Platform stakeholders. You will lead consultative conversations with senior customer leaders, listening deeply to uncover latent needs, walking them through quantitative and qualitative differentiators with live demos, building custom TCO models, and securing commitment to workshops, PoVs, or PoCs. You will author and continuously refine the sales motion playbook—not just updating assets, but rethinking the underlying strategy based on win/loss analysis and shifting market dynamics. You will design and deliver enablement programs that make field teams self-sufficient, reducing dependency on central specialists. You will lead customer-facing webinars and represent SageMaker AI Inference at flagship AWS events. You will write crisp, insight-rich documents—product feedback memos backed by customer evidence, market landscape analyses, and strategic recommendations—that directly shape roadmap decisions in sessions with product leadership. You will proactively identify and drive team-wide improvements: new mechanisms, process changes, or strategic pivots that raise the bar for the entire GTM organization.

We are a team of Generative AI Go-to-Market specialists with a unique blend of technical/specialist sales, product management, and technical business development backgrounds, driving global adoption and expansion of Amazon SageMaker AI as a flagship AWS managed GenAI Service.

You will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution that keep the program delivering against its targets, setting annual goals, defining what success looks like, and steering the program as conditions change.

A core part of this role is turning data into decisions. You will use analytical tools to build and maintain tracking and reporting that gives the business visibility into assessment volume, pipeline, engagement, and delivery performance, then translate those insights into clear business recommendations on where to invest, what to prioritize, and how to course-correct. You will own forecasting so leadership has a reliable forward view for resourcing and planning. Beyond internal execution, you will manage the third-party vendor and partner relationships OLA depends on — covering roadmap alignment, incentive structures, invoicing, and commercial coordination — while partnering closely with sellers, partners, and customers to shape licensing and assessment strategies.

Define and execute the OLA program strategy, owning the roadmap, annual goals, and delivery targets across multiple assessment offerings while identifying and negotiating complex partner and vendor deals.

new_jobs.description:
Overview

Search Platform is the retrieval and grounding foundation for Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents. Our shared services turn Microsoft 365 knowledge into trusted, permission-aware evidence through indexing, retrieval and ranking, and grounding. Product teams across Microsoft consume them through Microsoft Graph and Work IQ, and relevance teams ship quality on top of them. Every Copilot answer, search result, and agent action is only as good as the evidence behind it, so our job is to make every quality gain land faster, cheaper, and everywhere, and to prove it with data everyone trusts.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager on the Enterprise Search and Grounding Platform team to drive strategy and execution to deliver Copilot and Agents quality gains.

This position is based in Redmond, Washington and requires the employee be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

The strategy

Define the vision, multi-year roadmap, and success metrics for the Developer Experience pillar, anchored on the Search Platform north star: one trusted platform, tuned by scenario, with recall-forward, low-latency retrieval for agents.
Own product definition for the developer-facing API surface, including the next major version of our core retrieval API and the Work IQ and Retrieval API integration patterns, with a bias toward stable, scenario-agnostic contracts that outlive any single experience.
Decide what the platform should offer as a shared capability and what stays with individual agent teams, and drive the consolidation of bespoke integrations onto supported patterns.

Make the platform easy to build on

Design the onboarding path for a new agent team, from first call to production: reference integrations, documentation, samples, and self-serve tooling that remove the need for a bespoke engagement.
Treat debuggability as a product requirement. Specify the observability, tracing, and diagnostics developers need to understand why a query returned what it did and to fix issues without escalating to the platform team.
Translate agent needs into platform requirements for recall, latency budgets, and evidence formats, working with the Quality Improvements and Frontier Platform Innovation pillars so that recall-forward retrieval tuned for agents ships as part of the core platform.

Lead across the organization

Author crisp specs, requirements documents, and program plans; drive execution across multiple engineering teams and owners; and communicate status, risks, and trade-offs clearly to leadership.
Represent Search Platform developer experience with senior stakeholders across Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Graph, Work IQ, and partner organizations, landing decisions and aligning roadmaps.
Raise the bar for platform product management on the team by mentoring PMs and modeling data-driven, customer-obsessed decision making.

Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development
OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Significant experience shipping developer-facing platforms, APIs, or SDKs consumed by other engineering teams, including ownership of API design, versioning, and deprecation decisions.
Demonstrated ability to define a platform strategy and land it across organizational boundaries, influencing senior engineering and product leaders without direct authority.
Technical depth: comfortable with distributed systems and the trade-offs among latency, throughput, and cost, and able to engage credibly with senior engineers in design reviews.

Experience with search, information retrieval, retrieval-augmented generation, grounding, or LLM-based agent platforms.

This role will be based in San Francisco, Mountain View, Bellevue, or remote.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. This role may be remote or hybrid. new_jobs.description:
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.

Join us to transform the way the world works.

Job Description

This role will be based in San Francisco, Mountain View, Bellevue, or remote.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. This role may be remote or hybrid. At LinkedIn, hybrid roles are performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team. Remote roles are performed from the designated home work location upon time of hire, and any changes to this home work location requires a review of remote status and approval.

What this role is

We are building the platform that a new kind of agents run on. These agents take on real work inside a company: sourcing candidates, qualifying pipeline, handling RFPs, keeping operations moving. You will bring the right agents to the right customers, across a wide range of work.

Our go-to-market is still taking shape, and we are looking for someone with enough versatile business acumen to plug in and help create it.

The work will be a combination of three things: working directly with customers, working with cross-team and external partners, and turning what you learn in those rooms into elastic workforce playbooks. Those playbooks serve us internally, and they serve customers and partners driving AI transformation in their own organizations and with their customers. Expect a lot of discovery, and a lot of systematizing what you discover.

What you will own

Work with customers on their real deployments, and stay close enough to see what actually happens after the pilot.
Work with partners on how our agents reach and land in their accounts.
Turn those interactions into repeatable playbooks: what to deploy first, what to measure, what to expect, what to avoid.
Feed what you learn back into the product, so the next customer starts further along than the last one.
You will operate at all altitudes depending on what is needed: sourcing leads and closing deals, working directly with customers on deployments, collaborating on our pricing and packaging structure, and building playbooks for all of the above

How we work

Small team, real customers, short cycles. If you want a defined territory and an established playbook, this is not it. If you want to write the playbook, it is.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

BS/BA Degree in a technology related field OR equivalent experience
7+ years of experience in product management or equivalent role

Preferred Qualifications

8+ years of experience in product management or equivalent role
The judgment that comes with principal-level scope. You can set direction in an area that does not have one yet, and other people can follow it.
Business judgment that travels. You can move between a customer conversation, a partner discussion, and an internal roadmap review without losing the thread.
A bias toward systematizing. You do not just solve the problem in front of you, you write down how it is solved.
You are able to simplify. You have good judgment about what to leave out, and you make complicated systems feel obvious.
Ability to bring order, calm, and maturity to messy situations.

Product Management
Go-To-Market
External Customer Engagement

Overview

Microsoft Commerce is placing large bets across Consumer, Merchant, Partner, and Payments in a market being reshaped by agentic commerce and a live contest over the protocols and payer models that will govern it.

We are looking for a Principal Product Strategist, Commerce
to own the analytical and narrative spine of Commerce strategy: the person who can look across the whole agentic-commerce field and our position in it, size the opportunity, name the bet, and prove the business model works — then write it so it lands in the room.

This is an individual-contributor force-multiplier to the VP. The role sets net-new strategic direction that the pillar teams build against, holds the entire Commerce picture at once, and reaches a defensible call: what we bet on, who pays and why, how big the prize is, and the story that carries it through review. The ideal candidate reasons from first principles about business models and market opportunity, brings structure to high-stakes product decisions, and turns dense analysis into one clear, defensible narrative. Leverage comes from the quality of the thinking and the clarity of the call rather than the size of a team.

In this role you will own strategy across the full Commerce portfolio, including:

Market & competitive strategy: a first-principles POV on agentic commerce — the protocol landscape, the incentives of each major player, and where our advantage is real.
Monetization & business-model design: who pays and why across Consumer, Merchant, and Partner; payer models, methods, and sequencing that give the strategy a working economic engine.
Opportunity sizing & forecasting: market, feature, and monetization sizing from first principles — TAM → SAM → capturable, unit economics, ARR and ROI.
Decision frameworks for major bets: structure for high-stakes, ambiguous calls — build / buy / partner, sequencing, reversible vs. one-way-door, and where to place a bet across pillars.
Cross-thread synthesis: one coherent strategy across Consumer, Merchant, Partner, and Payments, with the conflicts surfaced before they collide in review.
Narrative & decision support: the strategy spine — MMM narrative, FY strategy papers, the investment case — written to land with senior stakeholders.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.

Responsibilities

Own a current, first-principles POV on the agentic-commerce market, the protocol landscape (for example ACP, UCP, AP2, MCP), and where Microsoft’s advantage is real.
Design and pressure-test monetization: the payer model across Consumer, Merchant, and Partner, the methods, and the sequencing.
Build the opportunity models and forecasts that let the org rank bets and defend investment asks with numbers, including ARR- and ROI-based justification.
Bring repeatable decision frameworks to major product bets so the reasoning is structured and legible.
Synthesize the Consumer, Merchant, Partner, and Payments threads into one coherent strategy and surface where they conflict.
Turn the analysis into the strategy spine — the MMM narrative, FY strategy papers, and investment cases — and prep the VP with a sharp POV and the two or three things that would change it.
Operate as a peer to senior leaders: form a POV, defend it, and change it on evidence.

new_jobs.title: Sr Product Manager (Tech), SCOT-AIM
new_jobs.description:
Description

Amazon’s SCOT-BizOps AI team is looking for an experienced Sr Product Manager (Tech) to conceptualize, articulate, and develop state of the art technology to measure and improve the shopping experience of every Amazon customer. The BizOps-AI team is a part of Amazon’s Supply Chain Optimization Technology (SCOT) organization, whose charter is to deliver the best possible customer experience and improve supply chain outcomes while maximizing the return on our inventory investment, fulfillment assets, and transportation network. We are never satisfied with the status quo and are convinced that there is always opportunity to innovate on behalf of customers.

Unlike brick and mortar stores where it is challenging to capture customer interest in a product unless they actually purchase the item, e-commerce offers the unique advantage of capturing customer "glance views" even if they don't convert to sales. Glance views, or GVs, are a leading indicator of potential future demand and allow us to capture a comprehensive set of data points (eg. price, delivery speed) to understand what we showed the customer and the resultant customer behavior. Amazon uses GV data to metricize and improve key performance indicators for customer experience like availability and promised delivery speed.

The person in this role will own Tier-1 CX and Supply chain metrics that provide stakeholders across Amazon with deep insights to identify and resolve defects. These metrics answer questions like: Was Amazon in stock on an item when customers were viewing it? Was the inventory in a location from where it could be immediately picked, packed, and shipped out to the customer? If not, what was the root cause? Your products will simplify the Business operations associated with these metrics, right from extracting insights from data, identifying opportunities for improvement, working with partner teams to deliver automated and scalable solutions, and providing regular performance/progress updates to stakeholders. You will build AI-powered solutions to automate repetitive tasks such as insight generation, identifying defects, debugging issues, developing/improving solutions for new use-cases and deploying fixes in production. This will involve managing the data infrastructure, software applications and CX interfaces.

The products you build will have a worldwide user base, spanning across multiple organizations that play a role in Amazon’s supply chain and the shopping experience we deliver to customer. You will own the process of first understanding what information is valuable to our internal customers and then working closely with our business intelligence, data engineering, and research science teams to deliver products that meet our customers’ needs in the long term. You will always be challenged to think several steps ahead so that the solutions you are building today will scale well with future growth and without adding excessive operational overhead. You will help define the product roadmap, serve as the voice of the customer, and champion your products across Amazon. You will work with worldwide retail category and supply chain operations teams, in-house scientists, other product managers, and software teams to define new features and products. You will analyze the potential customer and financial impacts, select the most promising ideas, prioritize them, and create a cohesive roadmap that makes the best use of available resources. You will also evangelize new features to our internal customers, working to accelerate feature adoption, track the realized impacts, and communicate results with senior leadership.

This is a highly visible role and will require regular interaction and communication with senior leaders. You must have the experience and capability to prepare documentation for senior executives and align your roadmap with Amazon’s strategic objectives. Excellent written and verbal communication skills are a necessity. Successful candidates should excel at diving into data in order to analyze problems and implement simple, long term solutions. You will have the opportunity to thrive in a highly collaborative, creative, analytical, and fast-paced environment oriented around building the world’s most flexible and effective supply chain management technology.

Key job responsibilities

Work with internal customers to understand their use cases and their existing solutions. Drive requirements definition, UI design, feature development priority, and product adoption/effectiveness.
Collaborate with your engineering and business teams to drive the product roadmaps.
Define product strategy and vision, and own the product roadmap and related literature.
Address bottlenecks, identify inefficiencies, anticipate and make tradeoffs; balance the business and customers’ needs versus technical constraints.
Own production of business metrics for Availability data-products- detecting anomalies, deep long-term trends and insight generation.
Lead technical product development for new strategic initiatives.
Own Business Requirement Documents, User Stories, Use Cases, and Product Strategy documents.
Evaluate technical solutions with alternatives and decompose significantly complex problems into concise and effective technical propositions.
Partner with multiple tech and product teams across multiple locations with varying sets of priorities to ensure a timely delivery of the solution.

A day in the life

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment.

The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
Maternity and Parental Leave Options

new_jobs.description:
Description

As a Senior Product Manager - Technical (PMT), Region Flexibility & Efficiency, you will own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for helping Amazon businesses operate against constrained resources while improving the efficiency and scale of our business. Working backwards from customer and business needs, you will define the end-state architecture that lets services break region coupling while retaining the ability to keep critical business functions within a region. You will also reduce the builder effort required to execute efficiency initiatives by delivering Agentic AI and headless solutions that connect the disparate tools across Amazon's ecosystem.

We are looking for a passionate, deeply technical, and customer-obsessed leader to define the Region Flexibility & Efficiency product and set the technical direction for fundamental architectural changes across the entire Amazon software stack. You will own the "what" and the "why": defining the customer problem, writing the narratives (PRFAQ, PRD) that align the organization, making data-driven prioritization and trade-off decisions, and defining the success metrics the initiative is measured against. You will partner closely with the engineering and program teams who own delivery, and influence architectural change across thousands of teams without direct authority.

Key job responsibilities

Own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Region Flexibility & Efficiency, and secure alignment from engineering teams and senior leadership.
Work backwards from customers and businesses to define requirements, and author the narrative documents (PRFAQ, PRD, product/technical specs) that drive decisions.
Define the target architecture and technical direction in partnership with principal engineers, evaluating trade-offs across latency, resiliency, cost, and complexity.
Define and track the metrics that measure product success, and use data to prioritize the roadmap and make build/no-build decisions.
Influence architectural change across thousands of teams, and communicate the product vision to audiences ranging from individual developers to senior leaders.

About The Team

The Region Flexibility & Efficiency (RFE) organization drives the optimization and resilience of Amazon's global infrastructure. We own programs that shape how Amazon operates across AWS regions, from enabling services to run flexibly across regions to driving petabyte-scale efficiency improvements that directly influence Amazon's infrastructure investment decisions.

Our portfolio spans infrastructure optimization programs, multi-region capacity strategy, fleet intelligence platforms, and agentic AI capabilities that automate performance improvements across hundreds of engineering teams. We support Amazon businesses including Stores, Prime Video, Alexa, and Kindle, and partner closely with AWS teams to improve both internal capabilities and public offerings.

This is a small, high-leverage team where individual contributors have direct impact at the highest levels of leadership. We value technical depth, hands-on execution, and the ability to operate across organizational boundaries. With millions of customers depending on Amazon's infrastructure every day, we build solutions that are robust, scalable, and designed to "just work" at Amazon's full scale.

new_jobs.description:
Overview

The AI Monetization Product
Team within the AI Experiences organizattion at Microsoft is responsible for building and scaling advertising, commerce, and revenue-generating experiences across Microsoft's AI and consumer ecosystem. Monetization decisions are only as good as the data behind them. Sales, Finance, Product, and leadership teams rely on trusted reporting to understand revenue performance, product adoption, customer value, forecasting, and the health of the business. Today, too much of that work depends on fragmented datasets, inconsistent definitions, and one-off reporting solutions that are difficult to scale or trust.

At Microsoft AI Monetization, we're looking for a Senior Product Manager – Reporting & Data Platform
to own the product direction for the data and reporting capabilities that help the business run. You will partner with Engineering, Sales, Finance, CRM, Analytics, and Product teams to turn their most important questions into durable platform capabilities: canonical data models, governed metrics, semantic layers, reusable datasets, and self-service reporting experiences.

This is not a dashboard-production role. You will build the foundation that allows other teams to create consistent reporting and insights on top of a shared source of truth. The role requires solid product judgment, comfort with data infrastructure, and a platform mindset: deciding what should be common, reusable, reliable, and easy for others to build on.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Define and execute the product roadmap for shared reporting and data-platform capabilities, balancing immediate business needs with investments that make future reporting faster, more reliable, and more self-service.
Partner with Sales, Finance, CRM, Analytics, Product, and Engineering teams to understand the decisions they need to make and translate those needs into prioritized data products and reporting capabilities.
Drive the definition of canonical business metrics, semantic models, and reusable data assets for key domains such as revenue, performance, customer value, product adoption, seller insights, forecasting, and planning.
Enable teams to build on the platform through governed datasets, clear definitions, reusable dimensions, APIs, documentation, and access patterns--reducing duplicate pipelines and inconsistent reporting.
Work with engineering and data teams to shape requirements for data ingestion, integration, modeling, quality, reliability, observability, governance, security, and cost efficiency.

Establish success measures for data quality, reporting reliability, platform adoption, time-to-insight, and reduction of manual reconciliation work.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, Amazon Intermodal
new_jobs.description:
Description

Amazon's Intermodal (AZIM) Network Optimization team is looking for a Senior Product Manager to drive the technology and product strategy that powers cost optimization and operational efficiency across the intermodal network, with a primary focus on drayage. This is a high-impact role responsible for translating complex supply chain problems — drayage cost reduction, carrier allocation, load planning, and ramp-level execution — into scalable product and automation solutions.

This role will own the product roadmap for drayage optimization tooling, partnering closely with engineering, operations, finance, and sourcing teams to define requirements, prioritize investments, and deliver capabilities that measurably reduce cost and manual effort. The ideal candidate combines strong technical product management skills with supply chain fluency, is comfortable navigating ambiguity to define what should be built and why, and thrives in a fast-paced environment where shipping product improvements directly impacts network economics.

Key job responsibilities

Drayage Product Strategy & Roadmap Own the product vision and roadmap for drayage optimization — including carrier allocation, load planning, cost modeling, and ramp-level execution tooling. Define what to build, sequence investments, and align stakeholders on priorities.

Requirements & Solution Design Translate operational pain points and cost reduction opportunities into clear product requirements and technical specifications. Partner with engineering to scope solutions that balance speed-to-value with long-term scalability.

Automation & Tooling Development Identify and eliminate manual processes across the drayage lifecycle by designing automated workflows, alerting mechanisms, and self-service analytics capabilities that reduce toil and improve decision speed.

Data & Metrics Ownership Define and instrument success metrics for drayage product initiatives. Monitor adoption, measure realized cost savings, and use data to iterate on product direction and prioritize the backlog.

Cross-Functional Partnership Collaborate with Network Optimization, Strategic Sourcing, Finance, and Operations to ensure product investments are grounded in business priorities and deliver measurable impact to the intermodal network.

Stakeholder Communication Present product strategy, progress, and outcomes to senior leadership. Articulate trade-offs clearly, build alignment on investment decisions, and advocate for the resources needed to execute the roadmap.

A day in the life

You'll start each morning reviewing drayage performance metrics and product dashboards to assess adoption, flag issues, and identify optimization gaps. From there, you'll work with Engineering to refine requirements, unblock development, or review sprint deliverables. You'll partner with Network Optimization and Operations teams to ground product decisions in real execution challenges — carrier availability, ramp constraints, cost variability. You'll sync with Finance and Sourcing to validate that product investments align with cost savings targets. When new opportunities surface, you'll scope the problem, size the impact, and build the case for senior leadership. Your customers are the AZIM teams that plan, execute, and optimize drayage operations every day.

About The Team

Amazon Intermodal (AZIM) is Amazon's internal intermodal transportation program, managing the movement of freight across the nation's Class 1 railroad network. The team oversees rail strategy, carrier relationships, operational execution, and financial performance for one of Amazon's most cost-efficient long-haul transportation modes. We partner closely with Strategic Sourcing, Drayage Operations, Security, and Finance to deliver reliable, secure, and cost-effective intermodal service at scale.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, Alexa Japan
new_jobs.description:
Description

Alexa Japan Product owns the Alexa+ experience for customers in Japan. We work closely with product, engineering, applied science, business development, and marketing teams across Amazon to make sure Alexa+ works even better for Japan than it does in any other locale. The decisions you make will reach millions of customers across Japan.

Alexa+ is the next generation of Alexa, rebuilt on large language models. We are bringing it to customers in Japan, and this is a rare opportunity to shape how a world-class AI assistant works in one of the most demanding and quality-conscious markets.

We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager to own a core part of the Alexa+ experience in Japan. You will own the roadmap for your product area, decide what needs to be built and in what order, and hold the bar for what a good experience looks like for Japanese customers.

Part of holding that bar is defining it: you will build the test cases that specify how the product should behave across the range of things Japanese customers ask for. When something does not work, you will dig into it yourself — reproduce the issue, narrow down where it breaks, and work with engineers and scientists to scope the fix.

You will spend time on which problems are worth solving, how to solve them, and what is needed to convince the right stakeholders to invest. This role suits someone who is comfortable with ambiguity, fluent enough technically to hold their own in a design review, and native in Japanese. You do not need a background in linguistics or machine learning research. You do need strong product judgment and the willingness to get into technical and linguistic details.

Key job responsibilities

Own the product roadmap and requirements for your area. Define the customer experience, write the specs and PR/FAQs, and set the success metrics.
Design the acceptance tests that define the product. Build the taxonomy of use cases and utterances your area has to support, write the seed test cases yourself, then use AI tooling to expand them into the hundreds or thousands of cases needed to prove the experience holds up.
Prioritize ruthlessly. Decide what absolutely needs to be built, what can be cut, and which quality bars are non-negotiable. Make the trade-offs between time, effort, and scope explicit.
Investigate product defects and quality issues. Reproduce them, isolate root cause with engineering and science partners, and turn findings into scoped, prioritized work.
Partner day-to-day with engineering, applied science, and marketing teams. Translate customer needs into technical requirements and align stakeholders on the plan.
Represent the Japanese customer. Use your own judgment of the language and cultural context to catch problems that metrics alone will not surface.
Define the KPIs for your area, own launch readiness including go/no-go criteria, and report progress, risks, and decisions to senior leadership.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with end to end product delivery
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
5+ years of technical product management, program management or engineering experience
Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese at a business level or above (N1+)
Experience investigating product defects and quality issues and driving them to resolution with engineers

Master's degree or above in an advanced technical degree field
Experience selling AI/ML solutions
Experience managing and delivering product quality or testing
Experience with competitive benchmarking and turning the findings into product requirements
